method: Keep0.57 research and optimizer policies fixed. Change only session ordering: research then deploy and retain revisions before starting the next task. The batched control researches all tasks before any deployment. The no-feedback control interleaves tasks but suppresses deployment revision retention while retaining initial research memory.
task_information: All researchers see the same public controls and scalar measurements. Only the first task changes its actual simulator after12 optimizer observations. Its learned revision can help two subsequent related tasks, with an intervening original-mechanism task.
endpoints: Successor research observations and compute, independent prediction loss, actual source-concept calls and rejected transfers, final optimizer objective/feasibility. The fixed total budget is 4 times 64 simulator calls per arm and sequence; fewer initial research observations leave more optimizer observations, not a claim of fewer total calls. Prediction evaluation scores initial research programs in each task's initial world; optimizer recommendations are scored in its final world. Primary prediction endpoints use successor tasks, whose worlds are stationary.
limitations: Development experiment on one four-task local simulator sequence. It tests the deployment feedback connection, not general autonomous research routing, a new structure family, or superiority over a general code Agent. No code-model calls.
